seoPage.title: Is EV Maintenance Expensive? Myth vs Reality | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: Is EV Maintenance Expensive? Myth vs Reality — practical ownership guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: The myth: EV servicing costs the same as luxury petrol bills. The reality: fewer engine items exist — tyres, brakes, filters, and software still need care.

editorialSections.title: The myth
paragraphs: Dealer quotes for unfamiliar parts can look high — compare what is actually scheduled vs petrol equivalents.

editorialSections.title: Practical reality
bullets: Regen can slow brake wear — inspections still matter.
Tyre costs remain — EV weight affects wear.
Authorised workshops matter for warranty and high-voltage work.

editorialSections.title: Where costs can rise
paragraphs: Out-of-warranty high-voltage repairs can be costly — read warranty before purchase.

faq.question: Are EVs cheaper to maintain?
faq.answer: Often lower routine engine work — budget tyres and scheduled checks.

faq.question: Software updates?
faq.answer: May be included or billed — ask the brand.

faq.question: Independent garages?
faq.answer: Fine for some items — not for all high-voltage jobs.

faq.question: Warranty void?
faq.answer: Skipping authorised service can affect claims — read terms.

faq.question: Compare?
faq.answer: Factor service network in your city when comparing brands.
